mutation: The `ev.case_id = e.case_id` comparison was removed from TRACEABILITY_SQL, so an evidence link resolving to a document in any case counted as traceability.
performedBy: manual mutation during Phase 3D, against the production EV-005 observer rather than a copy. 'a dangling evidence link does not satisfy the observer' went false: an assertion on one case, backed only by a document belonging to another organisation's case, was reported traceable. This is the failure the observer exists to catch — a citation that resolves to a real document proves nothing if the document is from a different matter.
